history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: From a bold founding vision in 1993 to one of Serbia's leading private universities — three decades of academic excellence, growth, and innovation.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.description: Alfa BK University — officially known as Karić Brothers University — was founded in Belgrade by the Karić family as one of the very first private universities in the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia. Its founding mission was to offer high-quality, practically oriented higher education as an alternative to the state university system.

milestones.title: First Graduating Class
milestones.description: The university welcomed its first class of graduates, primarily from the Faculty of Economics. The success of these early students established Alfa BK's reputation for producing practice-ready graduates who quickly integrated into Serbia's emerging private sector.

milestones.title: Expansion of Faculties
milestones.description: The turn of the millennium marked a major expansion: new faculties were established across business, languages, and sports management — transforming the institution from a single-faculty university into a full multi-disciplinary academic body. International cooperation agreements were signed with partner universities across Europe.

milestones.title: Bologna Process Integration
milestones.description: Alfa BK fully adopted the Bologna Process — restructuring all programs into the European three-cycle system: Basic Higher Education (BSc, 3 years, 180 ECTS), Master Programs (2 years, 120 ECTS), and Doctoral Studies (3 years, 180 ECTS). This aligned Alfa BK degrees with European standards and opened new pathways for student mobility.

milestones.title: National Accreditation
milestones.description: Following the adoption of the Law on Higher Education in Serbia, Alfa BK completed the national accreditation process for all its faculties and programs under the Commission for Accreditation and Quality Assurance (KAPK). This milestone cemented the university's legal standing and academic credibility.

milestones.title: Erasmus+ Partnership
milestones.description: Alfa BK was formally admitted to the Erasmus+ program, enabling student and staff exchanges with partner universities across the European Union. Within two years, over 100 students had participated in exchange semesters abroad, and the university hosted international students from 12 countries.

milestones.title: Faculty of Information Technologies
milestones.description: In response to growing demand for technology professionals in Serbia and the region, the Faculty of Information Technologies was officially established and accredited. It quickly became one of the most popular faculties, attracting students interested in software engineering, networks, and computer engineering.

milestones.title: Digital Transformation
milestones.description: In response to the global pandemic, Alfa BK rapidly deployed its E-Learning platform (Moodle-based), enabling uninterrupted online lectures, digital assignments, and remote examinations. This investment in digital infrastructure accelerated the university's long-term digital strategy and remains in active use as a hybrid learning model.

milestones.title: Re-Accreditation & Growth
milestones.description: All faculties successfully completed the national re-accreditation cycle. The university simultaneously expanded its doctoral studies offer, launched new research partnerships with industry, and signed cooperation agreements with universities in Russia, China, and the Gulf region.

milestones.title: Today — 30+ Years of Excellence
milestones.description: Alfa BK University enters its fourth decade with 6 accredited faculties, 15 academic programs, 2,400 enrolled students, 110 teaching staff, and graduates working in 34 countries. The university's continued focus on employability, research, and international cooperation keeps it at the forefront of Serbian higher education.

rector.name: Prof. dr Rade Milošević
rector.title: Rector
rector.bio: Professor Milošević has led Alfa BK University since 2018, driving the university's digital transformation, international expansion, and research strategy. He holds a PhD in Economic Sciences from the University of Belgrade and has published over 40 peer-reviewed articles on macroeconomics and higher education policy.

international.title: International Cooperation
international.subtitle: Alfa BK University maintains active academic partnerships with 60+ universities across 40+ countries — enabling student exchanges, joint research, and dual-degree programs.

mobilityPrograms.title: Erasmus+ Student Exchange
mobilityPrograms.description: Alfa BK students can spend one or two semesters in any of our 60+ Erasmus+ partner universities in Europe. Courses completed abroad are fully recognized towards your degree. Grants are available to eligible students to cover travel and living costs.

mobilityPrograms.title: Staff Mobility
mobilityPrograms.description: Academic and administrative staff can participate in Erasmus+ teaching and training mobility. Tenured professors visit guest lectures at partner universities and staff train in annual professional development programs abroad.

mobilityPrograms.title: Joint Research Projects
mobilityPrograms.description: Alfa BK participates in EU-funded and bilateral research projects with partner universities and industry. Research teams collaborate on projects in AI, economics, applied mathematics, and sports science.

mobilityPrograms.title: Dual Degree Programs
mobilityPrograms.description: Selected partner universities offer dual-degree pathways where students earn qualifications from both Alfa BK and the partner institution. Currently active with universities in Germany, France, and Poland.

instituteKaric.title: Institute Petar Karic
instituteKaric.subtitle: The scientific, cultural, and social institute of Alfa BK University — dedicated to advancing knowledge, fostering dialogue, and honoring the legacy of Petar Karić.
instituteKaric.heading: About the Institute
paragraphs: The Institute Petar Karic was established in memory of Petar Karic, one of the founding members of the Karic family who played a defining role in building the university from its earliest days. The Institute carries forward his values: dedication to learning, commitment to public good, and belief in the transformative power of education.

The Institute operates as the scientific and cultural arm of Alfa BK University. It organizes academic conferences, public lectures, student award programs, and cultural events that enrich intellectual life at the university and in the wider community.

It makes managing the scientific publications, practical activities, and institutional relations, centered about the sales of discoveries and tailored transboundary opportunities for a success social platforms.

activities.title: Scientific Research
activities.description: The Institute publishes peer-reviewed research in economics, law, technology, social sciences, and humanities. It maintains active research groups in applied economics and digital transformation.

activities.title: Cultural Programs
activities.description: Annual conferences, public lectures, film screenings, and art exhibitions are organized to foster dialogue between academic knowledge and broader cultural life in Belgrade and Serbia.

activities.title: Alumni Engagement
activities.description: The Institute acts as a bridge between the university and its graduates — hosting alumni lectures, mentoring circles, and professional development seminars throughout the academic year.

activities.title: Publications
activities.description: The Institute publishes the annual Alfa BK Academic Journal, conference proceedings, and topical monographs. All publications are available through the university library and selected open-access platforms.

activities.title: International Exchange
activities.description: Through bilateral agreements and participation in European networks, the Institute hosts visiting scholars, co-organizes international symposia, and supports collaborative research projects.

activities.title: Student Awards
activities.description: The Institute awards annual scholarships and prizes in memory of Petar Karic to students who demonstrate outstanding academic achievement, civic engagement, and leadership potential.
